resources.string: Security mode
Nothing you dictate stays on this phone
When it is on
Nothing dictated is kept
Once a dictation is in the field, Amber forgets it: no Try again, no Last dictation, no Insert again, Copy last or Undo last. A dictation that could not go in is gone.
Diagnostics without words
Only how many characters and words a dictation had, and its language.
Statistics without apps
Counts and times only. Which app you dictated in is not kept, nor how the text got into each app.
The clipboard stays untouched
Amber never puts text on it; using the clipboard when typing fails is off.
Amber\'s screens are hidden
No screenshots or screen recordings of Amber, and a blank picture in recent apps.
Switching it on deletes what is kept now: the last dictations and the app names in the statistics.
What it cannot do
It does not hide Amber
Anyone with your phone can see that Amber is installed.
It cannot reach other apps
What you dictated into a chat, a note or a mail stays there.
A server still gets it
A speech recognition or cleanup on a server still receives your recording or its text. Only speech recognition on this phone, with the cleanup off, keeps it all here.
Off in the security mode
Not inserted - the security mode keeps no copy
May still show up - the security mode keeps no copy
Screen was off - not inserted, the security mode keeps no copy
